description: This file contains the PHP class `Affiliate` which is part of the `Opencart\Admin\Model\Marketing` namespace. It manages marketing affiliates, including CRUD operations, retrieving reports, and counting affiliates. It extends a system engine model class and communicates with a database to perform these actions.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Represents the model for managing marketing affiliates, including CRUD operations, report handling, and data retrieval.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Inserts a new affiliate record into the customer_affiliate table with provided data.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates an existing affiliate identified by customer_id with new data.

methods.name: editBalance
methods.description: Updates the balance of a specific affiliate identified by customer_id.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Deletes an affiliate and associated report data for the given customer_id.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about an affiliate based on customer_id.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Fetches affiliate information using a tracking string.

methods.name: getAffiliates
methods.description: Retrieves a list of affiliates with optional filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalAffiliates
methods.description: Returns the total count of affiliates matching optional filters.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Fetches report entries for a specific affiliate, with pagination support.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all report entries associated with a particular customer_id.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Counts total report records for a given customer_id.
